summary: POSCO Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, announcing its provisional earnings and business plan for the second quarter of 2026. The filing schedules a conference call on July 30, 2026 at 3:00 PM KST for analysts, institutional investors, and press to discuss the results. This is a routine earnings notification with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes. The filing is a standard current report by a foreign private issuer, not triggering any special-situation category.
